component.name: Hamster Time Tracker for KDE
component.summary: Track your time, in Markdown files

description.p: A port of the Project Hamster time tracker to KDE. It is not an official Project Hamster release.
Type what you are doing, and Hamster keeps the time. The overview shows the activities of a day, a week, a month or any range, with totals per category, activity and tag.

ul.li: Everything is stored in Markdown files that can be read and edited by hand
The files can be kept in a folder synchronised between computers; each follows what the others write
Reports as HTML, TSV, XML and iCal
Provides the Hamster service for the Plasma widget, which is installed separately

description.p: First version packaged as a Flatpak.
